summary: Completed comprehensive testing of LOTR 5e RPG Treasure System with Famous Weapons/Armor Creator and DM Index. All 5 tabs working correctly (Generador, Armas Famosas, Índice DM, Precios, Tablas). Backend APIs tested and verified. UI interactions functional.
critical_code_review_comments: TreasureSystemSection.jsx: Well-structured with 942 lines, all data constants properly defined
MANUFACTURES constant (6 types): Númenóreana, Élfica (Eregion/Beleriand), Enana (Khazad-dûm/Erebor/Beleriand)
WEAPON_QUALITIES (23 entries) correctly filtered by manufactura type
ARMOR_QUALITIES (6 entries) with fixed costs in mp
PERDITIONS properly separated by elven vs numenorean
Price calculation in calculateWeaponPrice() applies quality multipliers and perdition costs correctly
50% probability for DM Index items implemented in generateMagicItem() function
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up test items (Hadhafang_Test) in treasure-index
context_for_next_testing_agent: Treasure System fully functional at /rules > Tesoros. 5 tabs tested: Generador (d20 magic rolls), Armas Famosas (weapon/armor/shield creator), Índice DM (persistent storage via MongoDB), Precios (cost tables), Tablas (reference tables). DM Index persists via PUT /api/data/treasure-index.
